metaTitle: Custom White Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom white lapel pins for events, uniforms, or recognition. Bulk pricing available at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: White lapel pins offer a clean, professional look that pairs well with any uniform or event attire. Whether you need them for employee recognition, fundraising campaigns, or corporate giveaways, white provides a neutral canvas that makes your logo or message stand out. Available in 1", 1 1/4", and 1 1/2" sizes, these pins can be printed with full-color designs or single-color imprints. The bright white background ensures high contrast for crisp, readable text and detailed graphics.
heroAltText: Assorted custom white lapel pins with colorful printed logos on a white background
